VPRegionBlock represents a collection of VPBasicBlocks and VPRegionBlocks which form a Single-Entry-Single-Exiting subgraph of the output IR CFG.

detaileddescription.para: A VPRegionBlock may indicate that its contents are to be replicated several times. This is designed to support predicated scalarization, in which a scalar if-then code structure needs to be generated VF * UF times. Having this replication indicator helps to keep a single model for multiple candidate VF's. The actual replication takes place only once the desired VF and UF have been determined.
